prompt.name: Social: Week in Posts
prompt.description: Plan 7 days of posts across your connected social channels. Generates copy, hashtags, and a publishing schedule.

stages.name: Research themes
stages.prompt: Identify 3 content themes for the upcoming week based on the brand and goal.

stages.name: Draft posts
stages.prompt: Write 7 posts (one per day) tailored to each requested channel. Include hashtags.

stages.name: Schedule
stages.prompt: Suggest a publishing time per post optimized for each channel's audience.
